headline: Australia’s mandatory government AI policy adds a seven-pattern use classification
summary: Australia’s Digital Transformation Agency says version 2.1 of its mandatory Policy for the responsible use of AI in government was published on 21 October 2026. Its new Appendix D defines seven usage patterns and requires covered agencies to apply them in use-case registers, impact assessments and transparency statements. An independent comparison reports that this replaces a four-pattern classification and adds explicit categories for strategic support, workflow automation and coding while changing other definitions. The DTA describes the changes as minor; the exact v2.0 policy PDF was unavailable for direct comparison, and no agency implementation or outcome evidence is established.
